description: This file defines a PHP class 'AboutOrganizationModel' in the 'OrangeHRM' system, representing a model for organization's about information in a REST API context. It implements methods for serialization to array, uses traits, and references external classes related to organization data and configuration.

classes.name: AboutOrganizationModel
classes.description: A model class for representing organization information in API responses, supporting serialization to array format based on user role.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with an AboutOrganization data object.

methods.name: getAboutOrganization
methods.description: Returns the internal AboutOrganization instance containing organization data.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the model data to an array, including additional employee counts if the user role is 'Admin'.
